```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
group_IDS <- read.csv('../data/anhedonics_matchedcontrols.csv')

birkbeck_demo <- read.csv('../data/birkbeck_demographics.csv') %>%
  subset(Response.Type=="response") %>%
  select(Participant.Private.ID, Question, Response)

birkbeck_age <- birkbeck_demo %>%
  subset(Question=="Your Age") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from="Question", values_from="Response")

birkbeck_race_ethnicity <- birkbeck_demo %>%
  subset(Question=="What is your ethnicity (check all that apply)?" & Response != "1" & Response != "4" & Response != "6" & Response != "7" & Response != "2") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from="Question", values_from="Response")

birkbeck_sex <- birkbeck_demo %>%
  subset(Question=="What sex were you assigned at birth, on your original birth certificate?" & Response != "1" & Response != "2" & Response != "3") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from="Question", values_from="Response")

birkbeck_gender <- birkbeck_demo %>%
  subset(Question=="What is your gender identity? (Check all that apply)" & Response != "1" & Response != "2" & Response != "3" &  Response != "5" &  Response != "9") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from="Question", values_from="Response")



boston_demo <- read.csv('../data/s2s_April 18, 2024_08.54.csv')[c(374:377, 9)]
names(boston_demo)[1] <- "Your Age"
names(boston_demo)[2] <- "What is your ethnicity (check all that apply)?"
names(boston_demo)[3] <- "What sex were you assigned at birth, on your original birth certificate?"
names(boston_demo)[4] <- "What is your gender identity? (Check all that apply)"

master_scored <- read.csv('../data/master_single.csv')  

master_birkbeck <- merge(master_scored, birkbeck_age, by.x="ResponseId", by.y="Participant.Private.ID") %>%
  merge(birkbeck_sex, by.x="ResponseId",by.y="Participant.Private.ID") %>%
  merge(birkbeck_race_ethnicity, by.x="ResponseId",by.y="Participant.Private.ID") %>%
  merge(birkbeck_gender, by.x="ResponseId",by.y="Participant.Private.ID")

master_boston <- merge(master_scored, boston_demo, by="ResponseId")

masterdemo <- rbind(master_birkbeck, master_boston)

groupdemo <- merge(group_IDS,masterdemo)

anhdemo <- groupdemo %>%
  subset(group=="Musical Anhedonics")

mcdemo <- groupdemo %>%
  subset(group=="Matched Controls")
```
